text: 从管线故事到业绩验证，创新药三季报行情仍可期？港股通创新药逆市活跃，520880标的指数成功收红
text_en: From pipeline stories to performance validation, is the innovative drug third-quarter earnings rally still foreseeable? Hong Kong Stock Connect innovative drugs were active against the market trend, and the 520880 underlying index successfully closed higher.
